retrievalProfile.description: A high-fashion portrait featuring a central figure in metallic textures posed against a heavily weathered, mud-caked vehicle in a bright desert environment.

recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle, wide-shot composition where a fashionably dressed subject reclines in the sand, framed by the wheel well of a destroyed, mud-covered vehicle under a bright, overcast sky.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between high-fashion metallic textures and gritty, dried mud
Subject framed by the circular geometry of a large vehicle tire
Low-angle perspective emphasizing the scale of the wreckage
Desaturated earth tones against a bright, hazy sky
coreInvariants: Heavily weathered and mud-caked vehicle textures

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally located, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame, reclining horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, mud-covered tire directly behind the subject's head and torso.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the subject's face, follows the diagonal line of the arm and leg, then circles the frame via the vehicle's body lines.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Bright, textured sky in the upper third provides breathing room for the dense, gritty textures below.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated beige and tan (mud, sand, sky)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal and black (clothing, vehicle shadows)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep burgundy and metallic silver (clothing details, jewelry)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the bright sky and dark, textured clothing.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Logo-like emblem consisting of concentric ellipses and a vertical axis
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair a minimalist geometric emblem with a clean, wide-tracked sans-serif for metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric purity of the corner elements.
Best for replicating the technical, celestial-style emblem.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-fashion portrait of a woman reclining in desert sand against a mud-caked, wrecked car. Use low-angle lighting and a desaturated earth-tone palette.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a thin-lined white geometric wireframe emblem in the top right corner, framed by four small corner brackets.

verificationChecks: Is the emblem line weight thin and uniform?
Is the emblem placed in the top right corner?
Does the emblem avoid overlapping the main subject?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the model

mustAchieve: Tactile, gritty texture on the vehicle
High-contrast lighting between subject and background

postGenerationChecks: Confirm the mud texture looks dried and crusty.
Ensure the sky is bright but retains cloud detail.
Verify the subject's pose feels editorial rather than casual.
Check that the metallic clothing reflects the ambient light.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Dystopian Wasteland Setting] + [High-Fashion Metallic Styling] + [Low-Angle Framing] + [Minimalist Geometric Graphic Overlay].
